divisions.label: The company
divisions.software_d: Smart products and custom AI for businesses. Our largest division, and the one that leads.

build.lead: The software division: smart products, each built for one line of work.
build.jasale_line: Smart work plans for every agent, orders and collections even with no signal, and one board for the manager.
build.club_line: A smart training plan for every age group, player cards that build themselves from voice notes, and a parent connection: regular updates and a monthly progress report on their child.
build.dl_line: A personal sales page and CRM for every distributor, and a live network tree for the leader.
build.custom_line: Smart tools that slot into your daily work, built around the way your business already runs:
custom_ex: Automated reports, quotes and customer follow-up
Data analysis that shows where you earn and where you lose

how.s1_d: Every product runs on the same proven core. We fit it to your business instead of starting from zero.
how.s2_d: We sit with your team, watch the real work, and turn it into screens and rules.
how.s3_d: Your team uses a working version within weeks. We improve it every week from what we hear.

trust.sec_d: Data is stored in managed, encrypted databases, and every request is checked against who is asking.
trust.perm_d: Each role sees only what it needs. An agent sees their own customers; a manager sees the team.
trust.minors_d: In SINAI Club, photos and videos of children need a parent's consent, and parents can withdraw it at any time.
trust.rights_d: SINAI Cinema records how each AI-generated asset was made, for a clear chain of title.
trust.priv_d: Your data is yours. We don't sell it or use it to advertise.

nums.f1: signal needed. Our apps keep working on the road, in the field and in the warehouse, and everything syncs when the connection is back.
nums.f2: system for the whole business. Field team, office and management see the same picture, each with their own permissions.
nums.f3: a smart chat answers your customers day and night and passes the leads straight to you.
nums.f4: languages from day one. The system speaks your team's and your customers' language, including Hebrew and Arabic right to left.

cinema.d: A streaming platform for independent AI-made film, and the studio behind the biblical drama Blood, Sand and Faith.

life.d: A healthy daily routine, with drinks from bHIP.
life.disclosure: Liran is an independent bHIP distributor; the brand and products belong to bHIP Global.
life.xgrn: A green morning drink with vitamins, minerals, fiber and plant ingredients: maca, matcha, moringa and spirulina. Low in calories, no added sugar.
life.indigo: An exotic, refreshing drink with acai, goji, green tea, guarana, maca and ginseng, with B vitamins and vitamin C. Vegan, gluten-free, no added sugar.
life.byng: A premium collagen supplement with a strawberry-lemon taste, for a daily beauty routine.

cta.h2: Let's put AI to work in your business.
cta.d: Tell us how your business works today. We'll show you where AI saves the most time.

about.p1: SINAI Global is a technology company from northern Israel. We build software that brings AI into the daily work of businesses, starting with the people who do the work.
about.bio: Operator, coach and builder. Ten years running sales and service operations, IDF Intelligence analyst and team leader, Industrial Engineering studies at the Technion. Today a physical education teacher and youth football coach who designs and ships software with AI coding agents.

sol.sub: When a ready product isn't enough, we build what you need: from one automation to a full app. Clear prices, up front.
sol.currency_note: Fixed prices per currency. Prices exclude VAT.
sol.p1_d: A working session with your team and a written map of where AI saves the most time. Credited toward any project you go ahead with.
sol.p2_d: A fast site in your languages, with a chat that answers customers and leads sent straight to you.
sol.p3_d: WhatsApp replies, automatic reports, CRM updates. Priced per process.
sol.p4_t: One of our platforms, fitted to your business
sol.p4_d: JaSale, SINAI Club or Downline HQ with your brand, your processes and your fields.
sol.p5_d: An app built from scratch around the way your business works, for phone and computer.
sol.p6_d: A standing team for improvements, new features and automations, every month.
sol.p7_d: Servers, backups, updates and monitoring, so everything keeps running.
sol.st1_d: We learn the work and agree on the one result that matters most.
sol.st2_d: A working version in your team's hands within weeks.
sol.st3_d: We launch, measure and improve every week.
sol.form_d: A few lines are enough. We'll get back to you soon.
